scope: Processing of personal data in Nigeria or of data subjects in Nigeria, incl. foreign controllers
applies_to: Data controllers and processors; those of major importance must register with NDPC and appoint a DPO
key_requirements: Section 24 processing principles; lawful basis/consent; breach notice to NDPC within 72 hours; registration of major-importance controllers
data_categories: Personal data and sensitive personal data (extendable by NDPC directive)
retention_period: Storage limitation principle (s.24); no fixed period found
penalties_range: Up to the higher of NGN 10M or 2% of annual gross revenue (major importance); NGN 2M or 2% for others
exemptions: Criminal investigation/prosecution, national public health emergencies, national security by competent authorities
notes: Replaces NDPR 2019; commenced on signing; GAID 2025 directive effective 2025-09-19
